title: Protocol and Machine
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: August Thackeray, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
